content.short: Sony Block Solutions Labs built Soneium, an OP Stack layer 2 for entertainment, gaming and creators.
content.description: Soneium brings one of the world's largest entertainment companies onchain. Sony's blockchain unit built it with Optimism's OP Stack, and it is part of the Superchain, so it shares bridges and standards with Base and OP Mainnet. The chain is EVM-compatible and settles to Ethereum. Its focus is consumer apps in gaming, music, anime and digital content, supported by Sony's global reach. Recent work includes support for ERC-8432, a standard for IP licences that both people and AI agents can read, and a partnership to bring K-pop IP onchain. Astar, Chainlink, Circle and The Graph are among its partners.
content.meta: Sony's OP Stack layer 2 for entertainment, gaming and creator apps in the Superchain. Explore Soneium on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
